verdict.rationale: Intuit documents a public QuickBooks Online V3 REST API. Official SDKs support it: a PHP client with create/read/update/delete examples and a Node.js OAuth 2.0 client with token refresh and a sandbox/production switch. An official MCP server wraps the API with full CRUD across 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving agents a usable way to drive the product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), an llms.txt, direct API reference pages in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration.
